skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain characteristics and procedures of accounting issues in internship units.
Evaluate and propose on organization and implementation of accounting work in domestic and international units.
Apply theories and characteristics to analyze, compare and explain organizational and implementation issues of accounting in units.
Possess basic computer skills for writing reports and presenting research findings.
Have critical thinking skills regarding the application of accounting standards and methods.
Develop communication skills to write reports about accounting internships.
Develop presentation skills to present about accounting internships.
Organize independent work, demonstrate personal responsibility and responsibility towards team work.
Identify and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics when making judgments and evaluations on specialized issues.
